title: The Bureau
caption: A quarter to two. She stands by the door and does not sit down.

lamps.means: the bureau's lamps — the one hanging over the room, Robineau's desk lamp, the telegraph table's: 0 out, 1 lit; between, lit low (dawn: the grey light from the window over lamps turned down)

office.means: the frosted glass in the door of Rivière's office: 0 dark, 1 lit from within

tape.means: the Morse inker: 0 still, 1 running — its paper tape creeping out and down over the table's edge

time.means: the clock over the map: minutes after midnight (105 — a quarter to two; 1325 — five past ten)

blue.means: the Patagonian mail's blue flag on the map: south — at Río Gallegos, where it sets out; san_julian — at San Julián; trelew — at Trelew; sea — out in the sea a hundred and fifty kilometres east of Trelew, at the bearing; off — taken down

west.means: the Chilean mail's yellow flag: air — over the Andes on the west line; field — at the field; off — taken down

north.means: the Asunción mail's green flag: air — up the river on the north line; field — at the field; off — taken down

red.means: the European mail's red flag: field — at the field, waiting; north — led on north, gone; off — taken down

outside.means: what the window shows at the hangar across the field: european — the night: the European mail in the lit gate being made ready; empty — it has gone, the gate lit and empty; rolled — at dawn, stood down: the mechanics rolling it back into the hangar; landing — the next evening: the floodlights lit, the Chilean mail coming down over the field, the next European in the gate; idle — the next evening with the night mail suspended: the floodlights dark, the gate half shut, Pellerin smoking by his plane

dusk.means: the hour's light, set by the scene's script from `time` (18:30–20:30): 1 — dusk, the afterglow in the window, no storm; the light's look `dusk`

dawn.means: the hour's light, set by the scene's script from `time` (5:30–8:00): 1 — dawn, a grey overcast lifting, cold light in the window; the light's look `dawn`

riviere_spot.means: where Rivière is (script.js lays it out from lib.SPOTS): map — standing before the map; desk — standing by Robineau's desk, at the telephone; bench — sitting on the bench by the telegraph; inker — standing at the telegraph table's left end, the inker before him (the tape in his hands: riviere_with tape); flags — close before the map's left half, turned to it, his right hand free to lead a flag

robineau_spot.means: where Robineau is (script.js lays it out): desk — standing behind his desk, his folder in his hands; writing — sitting at his desk over his report; bench — sitting on the bench by the telegraph, beside Rivière

pilot_spot.means: where the European mail's pilot is (script.js lays it out): standing — got up by the bench, his helmet in his hand; bench — sitting on the bench under the window, his helmet on his knees, waiting

telegraphist_spot.means: where the telegraphist is (script.js lays it out): table — at the telegraph table, leaning over the key; bench — sitting on the bench under the window (dozing, with telegraphist_mood eyes_closed)

riviere_a.means: where Rivière stands or sits, metres right of the middle (riviere_spot sets it; a piece walks it — beyond −3 outside the field door)

riviere_d.means: where Rivière stands or sits, metres away (riviere_spot sets it; a piece walks it — beyond 7.4 in the office, behind its door)

robineau_a.means: where Robineau stands or sits, metres right of the middle (robineau_spot sets it; a piece walks it — beyond −3 outside the field door)

robineau_d.means: where Robineau stands or sits, metres away (robineau_spot sets it; a piece walks it — beyond 7.4 in the office, behind its door)

pilot_a.means: where the European pilot stands or sits, metres right of the middle (pilot_spot sets it; a piece walks it — beyond −3 outside the field door)

pilot_d.means: where the European pilot stands or sits, metres away (pilot_spot sets it; a piece walks it — beyond 7.4 in the office, behind its door)

telegraphist_a.means: where the telegraphist stands or sits, metres right of the middle (telegraphist_spot sets it; a piece walks it — beyond −3 outside the field door)

telegraphist_d.means: where the telegraphist stands or sits, metres away (telegraphist_spot sets it; a piece walks it — beyond 7.4 in the office, behind its door)

madame_spot.means: where Madame Fabien is (script.js lays it out): door — by the door onto the field, her coat held round her; inker — behind the telegraphist's chair, reading over his shoulder

madame_a.means: where Madame Fabien stands, metres right of the middle (madame_spot sets it; a piece walks it)

madame_d.means: where Madame Fabien stands, metres away

asuncion_a.means: where the Asunción pilot stands, metres right of the middle (a piece walks it; beyond −3 — outside the field door)

asuncion_d.means: where the Asunción pilot stands, metres away

flag_hand.means: the flag in Rivière's hand, being led over the map (М1): none — none; blue, north, red — that flag, lifted from where its own key puts it (his right hand on it: script.js)

flag_to.means: where the led flag is going: one of that flag's places (blue — san_julian, sea; north — field; red — north, off: down into the drawer under the map)

flag_u.means: how far along its way the led flag is: 0 where it stood … 1 there (the game then sets the flag's own key to flag_to and flag_hand none)

flag_slip.means: the led flag sliding off its line, askew (a miss of М1): 0 upright on its pin … 1 slid down, leaning

drawer.means: the drawer of the small table under the map: 0 shut, 1 pulled open (the dawn's red flag goes into it)

tape_pull.means: the tape drawn out of the inker hand over hand (М9): 0 none … 1 a long strip out, its words come

receiver_off.means: the telephone's earpiece off its hook, in someone's hand (2.4)

tape_mark.means: what the drawn tape shows: words — groups of dots and dashes; line — one long line, no words; cut — words breaking off into nothing

office_door.means: the leaf of Rivière's office door, degrees: 180 shut … 98 open into the office

beat_next.means: the piece the game plays next (modules/beats: made ready ahead)

roblet.means: the game's: what Rivière did with Roblet (Ш1) — the piece `dawn` reads it: keep — he pushes the European's wing in the window; else his workbench is empty

robineau.means: the game's: what Rivière said to Robineau (3.7) — the piece `flags_down` reads it: sit — he takes the flags down with Rivière; work — at his desk, his eyes down; silent — not there

prompts.text: slow solo piano, sparse chords, nocturnal, restrained and dignified, French impressionist colour
distant morse telegraph clicks over a low string drone, tense and patient, night office
low strings sustained, slow, grave and tender, a long night of waiting
muted trumpet far away, a few long notes, lonely airfield at night
ambient engine hum, low propeller drone, airy pad, vast night sky
string quartet adagio, grave, restrained, noble sadness
celesta and harp, stars over clouds, weightless and cold
deep timpani rolls and low brass, a storm gathering far off
solo cello, long bowed notes, bitter and beautiful
minimalist piano ostinato, clockwork pulse, waiting for news
clarinet and bassoon, quiet and dry, an office at midnight
wordless choir very soft, high and far, moonlit sea of clouds
slow waltz on a small orchestra, faded, a lamp in a window
bowed vibraphone and reverb, cold blue air, stillness
orchestral swell, heroic yet sorrowful, dawn after a lost night
low horn chorale, slow, mourning without tears
